drafted_from: tool:save-a-form's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check a form, a list of questions people answer, and give it as one record the person's AI can keep in a store, so it can be asked and its answers checked", with {"form_id":"sample-intake","title":"Sample intake","questions":[{"questionId":"budget","questionTypeId":"number","label":"Budget"}]}. It runs tool:save-a-form and answers {"form_id":"sample-intake","record_id":"question-sequence:sample-intake","question_count":1,"record":{"id":"question-sequence:sample-intake","type":"question-sequence","value":{"kind":"question-sequence","formId":"sample-intake","title":"Sample intake","questions":[{"questionId":"budget","questionTypeId":"number","label":"Budget"}]}}}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it works only from the input it is given and keeps nothing; the AI reads the rows from a store and writes any result back to a store.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check a form, a list of questions people answer, and give it as one record the person's AI can keep in a store, so it can be asked and its answers checked", and give it form_id (The form's name, kept in the record id); questions (The questions, in order).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-a-form and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Returns the form as one question-sequence record ({ id, type, value }) and how many questions it holds. Nothing is kept: write the record to a store to keep it; the same form_id gives the same record id.
4. It keeps nothing: it is given the rows it works from as `records`, and answers its result for your AI to read or to write to a store.
